deals.deal: Buy One Get One Free Footlong for Sub Club Members
deals.desc: October 27 through November 8: every current or new Sub Club member (free account) gets a free Footlong of equal or lesser price with any Footlong bought in the Subway app or on subway.com. The offer sits in the app wallet automatically; one per order, add-ons extra, excludes Fresh Fit, 5 Meat Italian and Big Hot Pastrami. Choose turkey or veggie for a healthier pick. Stated in Subway's own October 21 newsroom release.

Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: Tropic Fan Fest: Free 24 oz Smoothie with Any Bowl or Food Purchase, Every Day
deals.desc: November 2 through 8: Tropic Rewards members (free account) get a free 24 oz smoothie with any Tropic Bowl or food item, once a day, all week. Add the food and a smoothie to an app or tropicalsmoothiecafe.com order and tap Apply on the Tropic Fan Fest reward, or scan the app in the cafe; the credit covers the lowest-priced 24 oz smoothie. Excludes Toasted Snack Rolls, the Sunshine Smoothie, sides, sweets and kids' items; participating cafes.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Wednesday in most Sprouts Farmers Market locations, select Oumi sushi rolls from the in-store sushi case are $6 each instead of the regular $8 to $10 (verified in store October 2026; the chain's older FAQ still says $5). Walk in and grab them: no coupon, app, or membership needed; participation and selection vary by store.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Kroger-family stores with a Snowfox sushi counter (Kroger, Fry's, King Soopers and other banners) sell the Wednesday Only promo lineup, including spicy tuna, Philly, California and veggie rolls, for $6 a roll (up from $5 in 2025) versus $8 to $10 the rest of the week. Walk in; a free Kroger Plus card may be needed for the promo price.

deals.deal: $5 Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls for $5
deals.desc: Every Wednesday at Publix stores with a sushi counter, select fresh-made rolls (spicy tuna, California, spicy shrimp, cream cheese/Philadelphia-style, vegetable and more; selection varies by store) are $5 each instead of the usual $6 to $10. Walk in and grab them from the sushi case: no app, coupon, or membership needed, while supplies last.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Nori Sushi Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Wednesday at participating Hy-Vee stores with a Nori Sushi counter, select rolls are $6 each (regularly about $8 to $10). A store-run promotion: some stores run buy one, get one 50% off instead, so price and selection vary by store; no card or app is needed.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Sushiya Rolls for $7
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, H-E-B stores with an in-store Sushiya counter sell select fresh rolls for $7 (regularly about $9 to $12). No coupon or app needed; selection varies by store and sells out by evening.

Every Wednesday, participating ShopRite stores sell select fresh sushi rolls (spicy crab, California and more) for $5.99, regularly $8 to $10. In-store only; ShopRite stores are independently owned, so selection and participation vary.

deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Weis Markets stores with a Snowfox sushi counter sell selected rolls, as marked in the case, for $5 each (regularly $7 to $9). In store only, no card or app needed, while supplies last.

deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Food Lion stores with a Hissho sushi counter sell select fresh rolls for $5 each (regularly $7 to $9). Grab them from the sushi case during counter hours; no card, coupon or app needed, while supplies last.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls for $4.99
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Lowes Foods sells select hand-rolled sushi from its in-store counter for $4.99 a roll (regularly $7 to $9). In store, no card or app needed, while supplies last.

deals.deal: $5 Sushi Wednesday: California, Spicy California & Vegan Rolls
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Hannaford's Wago sushi counters sell the California, Spicy California and Classic Vegan rolls for $5 each (regularly $7 to $8). In store only, no card or app needed, while supplies last.
Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
deals.desc: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage.
deals.expires: Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends

deals.deal: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
deals.desc: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers.
